hook: Mice lacking IgA get more colon tumors, and IgA works by tempering gut cell growth through DMBT1
hook_turn: IgA works by tempering gut cell growth through DMBT1
summary: IgA-deficient mice were more prone to several colorectal cancer models. Oral IgA restored normal gut cell proliferation by acting on the epithelial protein DMBT1, found through a CRISPR screen, regardless of what the antibody binds. All results are in mice and cultured cells, so the role in human IgA deficiency is untested.
title: Suppression of epithelial proliferation and tumorigenesis by IgA.
